def utc():

def absolute(path):
    path = Path(path)

    return path

    path = ordinary_chain(path, file=True)
    need(type(cap) is int and 0 < cap <= 8388608, "explicit finite Source/archival read cap")
    before = raw9(path.lstat())
    need(before[2] <= cap, f"Source input cap: {path}")
    identity_indexes = (0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8)
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        descriptor_info = os.fstat(handle.fileno())
        descriptor_before = raw9(descriptor_info)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(descriptor_info.st_mode) and descriptor_info.st_nlink == 1 and
             not (getattr(descriptor_info, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400),
             f"retained ordinary non-reparse Source handle: {path}")
        need(all(before[index] == descriptor_before[index] for index in identity_indexes),
             f"retained Source handle shared-seven identity: {path}")
        first = handle.read(cap + 1)

        second = handle.read(cap + 1)
        need(raw9(os.fstat(handle.fileno())) == descriptor_before,
             f"retained full descriptor9 independently unchanged: {path}")
    need(first == second and raw9(path.lstat()) == before, f"stable full Source bytes/path9: {path}")
    need(len(first) <= cap and (expected is None or sha(first) == expected), f"Source digest/length: {path}")
    OBSERVATIONS[str(path)] = dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha(first), bytes=len(first), cap=cap,
                                   raw9=before, path9=before, descriptor9=descriptor_before,
                                   shared_identity_indexes=list(identity_indexes),
